description.7.0: Sample liner responses. The nodes of an element will be ordered counterclockwise with respect to the outside of the zone faces upon which the liner was created.
description.9.0: ELEMENT SPEC REQUIRED: after the quantity keyword, the target must be identified with 'component-id <i>' or 'position <v>' — otherwise the engine rejects with 'Must specify an element, by component-id or position.' Verified live against FLAC3D 9.7 (beam and shell families; both forms created histories).

notes: '[linerhistoryblock]' at the end of a keyword's syntax is not a literal token: it marks where this command's shared modifier keywords may follow (component-id, depth-factor, node, position, side, surface-x, name).

description.7.0: displacement in the normal coupling spring at a node of the element. Sign convention for a normal spring is +/-, indicating separation/overlap. This option uses the node and side keywords.
description.9.0: displacement in the normal coupling spring at a node of the element. Normal displacement positive/negative implies separation/overlap only if the liner is on the outer surface and liner element normals point away from the body to which the liner is attached. This option uses the node and side keywords.

description.7.0: displacement in the shear coupling spring at a node of the element. Shear springs store displacement magnitude, and this is always positive. This option uses the node and side keywords.
description.9.0: displacement in the shear coupling spring at a node of the element Shear displacement is always positive. This option uses the node and side keywords.

description.7.0: stress in the normal coupling spring at a node of the element. The sign convention for normal spring is +/-, indicating separation/overlap. This option uses the node and side keywords.
description.9.0: stress in the normal coupling spring at a node of the element. Normal stress positive/negative implies tension/compression only if the liner is on the outer surface and liner element normals point away from the body to which the liner is attached. This option uses the node and side keywords.

description.7.0: stress in the shear coupling spring at a node of the element. This option uses the node and side keywords.
description.9.0: stress in the shear coupling spring at a node of the element. Shear stress is always positive. This option uses the node and side keywords.

description.7.0: yield state in the coupling spring at a node of the element. Value {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively. This option uses the node and side keywords.
description.9.0: yield state in the shear coupling spring at a node of the element. Value {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively. This option uses the node and side keywords.

description.7.0: the element is selected by its individual component ID number
description.9.0: the element with component ID ind is selected.

description.7.0: the depth factor used to determine element stresses. Only available if noted.
description.9.0: the depth factor at which elastic element stresses are computed (see the structure liner recover stress command). If this keyword is not specified, then the depth factor is set to +1. Only available if noted.

keywords.name: integration-point
keywords.description: the integration point at which stresses are sampled. Integration-point locations follow the plastic-integration layout configured with 'structure <type> cmodel plastic-integration'; the layout figure is on the official Structural Elements formulation pages (the original hyperlink target, lost in extraction). If this keyword is not specified, then the integration point index is set to 1 . Only available if noted.

description.7.0: the node location to use when retrieving values from the element. Must be from 1 to 3. Only available if noted.
description.9.0: the node location to use when retrieving values from the element. Must be from 1 to 3 . If this keyword is not specified, then the node location is set to 1 . Only available if noted.

keywords.name: position
keywords.description: the element with a centroid closest to v is selected

description.7.0: specifies the side of an embedded liner from which to retrieve coupling values. By default, this is side 1.
description.9.0: the side of an embedded liner. Must be 1 or 2 , with default value of 1 .

description.7.0: the local \(x\)-direction used to determine the local surface coordinate system. Only available if noted.
description.9.0: the surface-x vector whose projection onto the element plane defines the x-direction of the surface coordinate system (see the structure liner recover surface command). If this keyword is specified, then the surface coordinate system of the three nodes used by the element will be modified.

keywords.name: coupling-yield-shear
keywords.description: yield state in the shear coupling spring at a node of the element. Value {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively. This option uses the node and side keywords.

keywords.name: coupling-yield-normal
keywords.description: yield state in the normal coupling spring at a node of the element. Value {0, 1, 2} denotes never yielded, now yielding, or yielded in the past, respectively. This option uses the node and side keywords.
